topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes, learning outcomes, and conceptual framing for cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Cell-Intrinsic Drivers of Malignancy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cell-intrinsic genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive advantages and drive the acquisition of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how tissue stemness hierarchies and the cell of origin influence cancer development across leukemia and colorectal models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Promotion of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how environmental exposures and chronic inflammatory signaling create permissive niches that promote neoplastic outgrowth.

topics.label: The Established Microenvironment, Spatial Profiling, and Tumor Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the role of supportive stroma in established tumors, analytical methods for mapping cellular interactions, and the integrated model of cancer coevolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and provides a brief lookahead to the next lecture on cancer therapy.
